citations.assessment: Part I explicitly places Rav Yose’s tenure after Rav Sama and quotes the end of instruction. The neighboring chronologies use different date notation.
The Epistle attributes the end of instruction to Rav Yose’s days and associates it with the completion of the Talmud. This is the Epistle’s historical periodization.

holds.reason: The received heading leaves the number abbreviated. The Part I context shows millennium notation attached to Rav Sama’s date. Neither checked passage supplies a four-year tenure or an exact accession year for Rav Yose.
